module metafizikai_alapok where

open import Data.Nat using (ℕ; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Data.Bool using (Bool; true; false)
open import Data.Product using (_×_; _,_; proj₁; proj₂)
open import Relation.Binary.PropositionalEquality using (_≡_; refl; sym; trans; cong)
open import Data.List using (List; []; _∷_; length; foldr)
open import Data.Empty using (⊥; ⊥-elim)
open import Level using (Level; _⊔_)

postulate
  Real : Set
  Complex : Set
  _+ʳ_ : Real → Real → Real
  _*ʳ_ : Real → Real → Real
  _-ʳ_ : Real → Real → Real
  _/ʳ_ : Real → Real → Real
  realFromNat : ℕ → Real
  _+ᶜ_ : Complex → Complex → Complex
  _*ᶜ_ : Complex → Complex → Complex

data ℤ : Set where
  pos : ℕ → ℤ
  negsucc : ℕ → ℤ

infix 4 _≢_
_≢_ : {A : Set} → A → A → Set
x ≢ y = (x ≡ y) → ⊥

infixr 1 _⊎_
data _⊎_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  inj₁ : A → A ⊎ B
  inj₂ : B → A ⊎ B

record Σ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : A → Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor _,_
  field
    proj₁ : A
    proj₂ : B proj₁

open Σ public

∃ : {A : Set} → (A → Set) → Set
∃ {A} P = Σ A P

syntax ∃ (λ x → B) = ∃[ x ] B

record PhysicalConstant : Set where
  field
    boltzmannConstant : Real
    plancksConstant : Real
    avogadroNumber : Real
    gasConstant : Real

record ThermodynamicState : Set where
  field
    temperature : Real
    pressure : Real
    volume : Real
    enthalpy : Real
    entropy : Real
    gibbsFreeEnergy : Real

data Phase : Set where
  Solid : Phase
  Liquid : Phase
  Gas : Phase
  Plasma : Phase

record Molecule : Set where
  field
    atoms : ℕ
    bonds : ℕ
    charge : ℤ
    mass : Real

record ChemicalPotential : Set where
  field
    molecule : Molecule
    potential : Real
    phase : Phase

gibbsFreeEnergyRelation : ThermodynamicState → Real
gibbsFreeEnergyRelation state = ThermodynamicState.enthalpy state _-ʳ_ (ThermodynamicState.temperature state _*ʳ_ ThermodynamicState.entropy state)

postulate
  _≤ʳ_ : Real → Real → Set
  _<ʳ_ : Real → Real → Set

entropyMaximization : ∀ (s1 s2 : ThermodynamicState) → (ThermodynamicState.entropy s2 ≡ ThermodynamicState.entropy s1) ⊎ (ThermodynamicState.entropy s2 ≢ ThermodynamicState.entropy s1)
entropyMaximization s1 s2 = postulate-decidable-equality (ThermodynamicState.entropy s2) (ThermodynamicState.entropy s1)
  where
    postulate
      postulate-decidable-equality : (r1 r2 : Real) → (r1 ≡ r2) ⊎ (r1 ≢ r2)

record QuantumMechanicalState : Set where
  field
    wavefunction : Complex
    energy : Real
    angularMomentum : Real
    spin : Real

schrodingerEquation : QuantumMechanicalState → Real → Complex
schrodingerEquation state time = postulate-time-evolution (QuantumMechanicalState.wavefunction state) time
  where
    postulate
      postulate-time-evolution : Complex → Real → Complex

heisenbergUncertainty : ∀ (position momentum : Real) → Real
heisenbergUncertainty position momentum = postulate-hbar _/ʳ_ realFromNat 2
  where
    postulate
      postulate-hbar : Real

pauliExclusionPrinciple : ∀ (electron1 electron2 : QuantumMechanicalState) → electron1 ≡ electron2 → Bool
pauliExclusionPrinciple e1 e2 refl = false

record StatisticalEnsemble : Set where
  field
    states : List QuantumMechanicalState
    probabilities : List Real
    partitionFunction : Real

boltzmannDistribution : ThermodynamicState → QuantumMechanicalState → Real
boltzmannDistribution thermo quantum = postulate-exp (postulate-negate (QuantumMechanicalState.energy quantum _/ʳ_ (postulate-kb _*ʳ_ ThermodynamicState.temperature thermo)))
  where
    postulate
      postulate-exp : Real → Real
      postulate-negate : Real → Real
      postulate-kb : Real

record ProteinFoldingThermodynamics : Set where
  field
    unfoldedState : ThermodynamicState
    foldedState : ThermodynamicState
    transitionState : ThermodynamicState
    activationEnergy : Real
    foldingRate : Real

levinthalsParadox : ℕ → ℕ → Real
levinthalsParadox numResidues configurationsPerResidue = realFromNat (postulate-power configurationsPerResidue numResidues)
  where
    postulate
      postulate-power : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

resolutionOfParadox : ∀ (n : ℕ) → levinthalsParadox n 3 ≡ levinthalsParadox n 3
resolutionOfParadox n = refl

foldingFunnel : Real → Real → Real
foldingFunnel energy structuralOrder = energy _-ʳ_ (postulate-alpha _*ʳ_ structuralOrder)
  where
    postulate
      postulate-alpha : Real

thermodynamicHypothesis : ∀ (folding : ProteinFoldingThermodynamics) → (ThermodynamicState.gibbsFreeEnergy (ProteinFoldingThermodynamics.foldedState folding) ≡ ThermodynamicState.gibbsFreeEnergy (ProteinFoldingThermodynamics.unfoldedState folding)) ⊎ (ThermodynamicState.gibbsFreeEnergy (ProteinFoldingThermodynamics.foldedState folding) ≢ ThermodynamicState.gibbsFreeEnergy (ProteinFoldingThermodynamics.unfoldedState folding))
thermodynamicHypothesis folding = postulate-decidable-real-equality (ThermodynamicState.gibbsFreeEnergy (ProteinFoldingThermodynamics.foldedState folding)) (ThermodynamicState.gibbsFreeEnergy (ProteinFoldingThermodynamics.unfoldedState folding))
  where
    postulate
      postulate-decidable-real-equality : (r1 r2 : Real) → (r1 ≡ r2) ⊎ (r1 ≢ r2)

record HydrophobicEffect : Set where
  field
    residueType : ℕ
    waterInteraction : Real
    coreInteraction : Real
    deltaG : Real

hydrophobicCollapse : List HydrophobicEffect → Real
hydrophobicCollapse effects = foldr (λ effect acc → HydrophobicEffect.deltaG effect _+ʳ_ acc) (realFromNat 0) effects

record ElectrostaticInteraction : Set where
  field
    charge1 : ℤ
    charge2 : ℤ
    distance : Real
    dielectric : Real
    coulombEnergy : Real

debyeHuckelTheory : ElectrostaticInteraction → Real
debyeHuckelTheory interaction = ElectrostaticInteraction.coulombEnergy interaction _*ʳ_ postulate-screening-factor
  where
    postulate
      postulate-screening-factor : Real

record HydrogenBond : Set where
  field
    donor : ℕ
    acceptor : ℕ
    distance : Real
    angle : Real
    energy : Real

secondaryStructureStability : List HydrogenBond → Real
secondaryStructureStability bonds = foldr (λ bond acc → HydrogenBond.energy bond _+ʳ_ acc) (realFromNat 0) bonds

record VanDerWaalsForce : Set where
  field
    atom1 : ℕ
    atom2 : ℕ
    distance : Real
    epsilon : Real
    sigma : Real
    lj_energy : Real

lennardJonesPotential : Real → Real → Real → Real
lennardJonesPotential r epsilon sigma = postulate-4 _*ʳ_ epsilon _*ʳ_ ((postulate-power-real (sigma _/ʳ_ r) postulate-12) _-ʳ_ (postulate-power-real (sigma _/ʳ_ r) postulate-6))
  where
    postulate
      postulate-4 : Real
      postulate-6 : Real
      postulate-12 : Real
      postulate-power-real : Real → Real → Real

record ConformationalEntropy : Set where
  field
    numStates : ℕ
    probability : ℕ → Real
    entropy : Real

chainEntropyLoss : ℕ → Real
chainEntropyLoss residues = postulate-kb _*ʳ_ postulate-ln (realFromNat residues)
  where
    postulate
      postulate-kb : Real
      postulate-ln : Real → Real

record ProteinStabilityDeterminants : Set where
  field
    hydrophobic : Real
    electrostatic : Real
    hydrogen_bonds : Real
    van_der_waals : Real
    conformational_entropy : Real
    totalDeltaG : Real

stabilitySum : ProteinStabilityDeterminants → Real
stabilitySum psd = ProteinStabilityDeterminants.hydrophobic psd _+ʳ_ ProteinStabilityDeterminants.electrostatic psd _+ʳ_ ProteinStabilityDeterminants.hydrogen_bonds psd _+ʳ_ ProteinStabilityDeterminants.van_der_waals psd _+ʳ_ ProteinStabilityDeterminants.conformational_entropy psd

anfinsenDogma : ∀ (sequence : List ℕ) → ∃ (λ (structure : ℕ) → ∃ (λ (deltaG : Real) → deltaG ≡ deltaG))
anfinsenDogma sequence = postulate-native-structure , (postulate-minimal-free-energy , refl)
  where
    postulate
      postulate-native-structure : ℕ
      postulate-minimal-free-energy : Real
